evals.name: stuck
evals.prompt: My toy Redis in Go works for one client but hangs when a second redis-cli connects. I accept connections in a loop and call handle(conn) directly. Why?
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses and gives a minimal fix or hint rather than rewriting the server; Identifies that handle(conn) blocks the accept loop and must run concurrently (e.g. `go handle(conn)`) or use an event loop
